summary: Implemented the SHACL path parsing utility. Added rdflib/extras/shacl.py with parse_shacl_path(shapes_graph, path_identifier) and the SHACLPathError exception, and test/test_extras/test_extras_shacl.py with a parametrized valid/invalid test, a non-node input test, and a graph-unchanged test. The new tests and the existing test/test_path.py pass (42 tests) under the shared venv Python. Not verified: mypy, black and isort are not installed in the shared venv, so type-ignore placement, line length and import order were checked by reading only. No commits were made, and no existing modules, __init__ files or dependency files were changed.
